validity.recommendation: keep the row; restate SegmentName as 'Appalachia to Market Project (FERC CP20-436)' - 'TEAM 2021 Expansion' is a GEM-coined label that appears in no source and invites confusion with the four TEAM/A2M siblings
validity.researcher_notes: IDENTITY FIRST (the orchestrator's question - which named TETCO project is this row?). This row is the APPALACHIA TO MARKET PROJECT, FERC docket CP20-436-000, certificated by 172 FERC para 62,184 on 30 September 2020 and placed in service 1 November 2021. Every recorded spec on the row maps to that project and to nothing else: 30-inch (the Delmont Loop is 30-inch), 18 MMcf/d (= the certificated 18,000 Dth/d to UGI Utilities), $22M (= the $21.5M estimate), StartYear1 2021 (in service 1 Nov 2021), Pennsylvania -> Pennsylvania (Westmoreland/Berks/Fayette Counties), Enbridge. The identification is certain, not inferred - 18,000 Dth/d at 30-inch in PA is a unique signature in the whole EIA series. NAME: 'Texas Eastern Appalachia to Market (TEAM) 2021 Expansion' is GEM's own coinage; FERC, EIA, the Federal Register, Enbridge's 8-K and the Harvard ELR all call it simply the 'Appalachia to Market Project'. It is NOT a TEAM project: the TEAM family (TEAM 2012, TEAM 2014, TEAM South) are separate, much larger Texas Eastern expansions with their own dockets. Recommend SegmentName 'Appalachia to Market Project (FERC CP20-436)'. NOT A DUPLICATE of any sibling row in scope: P0235 = Ohio Pipeline Energy Network (OPEN, Ohio, 76 mi); P0260 = TEAM 2014 (Uniontown PA -> NJ, 34 mi, $500M); P0261 = TEAL, the Texas Eastern Appalachian Lease (Ohio, 5 mi); P5832 = TEAM 2012 (PA/WV, 17.3 mi); P2562 = Middlesex Extension (CP20-30, NJ, 1.75 mi, 264 MMcf/d). The only near-miss on SIZE is P2562 (1.75 mi), which is a different docket, a different state, a different diameter and a 15x larger capacity. AND NOT A DUPLICATE of the three other 'Appalachia to Market' entities EIA carries, which a future sweep will meet: (a) 'Appalachia to Market Project (A2M Project)', Texas Eastern, OH/WV/PA/NJ, 1,000 MMcf/d, docket 'na' - CANCELLED in every EIA release from May 2018 to Aug 2026, a different and far larger project that merely shares the name; (b) 'Appalachia to Market II (Armagh-Entriken HP Replacement Project)', CP22-486, PA/NJ, 2 mi, 36-inch, 55 MMcf/d, $368M, in construction, in service now 2027; (c) 'Appalachia to Market III Project', CP25-491, DE/PA, 2 mi, 36-inch, 32 MMcf/d, $42.2M, approved. None of those is this row. EXISTENCE and CLASSIFICATION are not in doubt: the project is documented end to end in FERC's public docket (application, EA, certificate order, in-service compliance filing), in 20 consecutive EIA releases, in the Harvard ELR's appendix of FERC certificate orders, and in Enbridge's own SEC filings; Status 'operating', Fuel 'Gas' and PipelineType 'transmission' are all correct. CAVEAT ON THE HARVESTED CITATION POOL, which the brief requires be reported: all 23 carried citations for this ProjectID come from the SHARED Texas Eastern Transmission (TETCO) system page and NOT ONE of them names the Appalachia to Market project or docket CP20-436. They cover OPEN, TEAM 2014, TEAL, Cameron/Venice, a bit.ly Enbridge redirect, EIA's https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/data.php navigation page (which states nothing about any pipeline and is not citable), and a waytogoto.com wiki mirror. Every ref staged on this shard is therefore newly found, not re-verified. ROUTE: the routes repo holds only a 215-byte placeholder (P5835.geojson, "geometry": null), so the row is routeless and no route-vs-sheet conflict exists.

cross_row_leads.topic: P2008 (deepsweep-remainder) - contested TETCO identity; does P5835's evidence bear on it?
cross_row_leads.note: DIRECT ANSWER: P5835 is definitively NOT the same project as P2008, and nothing on this shard rehabilitates P2008's recorded numbers. P5835 = Appalachia to Market Project, CP20-436, 0.8 mi, 30-inch, 18 MMcf/d, $21.5M, in service 1 Nov 2021, Westmoreland/Berks/Fayette Counties PA. P2008 records 53.10 km / 33.0 mi, $500M, 395 MMcf/d with TEAM 2012-era dates and Clarington OH signals - two orders of magnitude apart on every physical spec. No overlap, no duplicate risk between these two rows. P2008 IS NOT EDITED by this shard. TWO THINGS MY RESEARCH DID SURFACE that bear on P2008's open identity question, offered as leads only: (1) EIA's local corpus carries a genuinely CANCELLED 'Appalachia to Market Project (A2M Project)' - Texas Eastern Transmission, states OH/WV/PA/NJ, 1,000 MMcf/d, docket 'na', status Cancelled in EVERY release from May 2018 through Aug 2026. That cancelled A2M is a much better fit than TEAM 2012/2014 for any GEM row whose classification concern is 'cancelled vs operating', because it is a large multi-state Texas Eastern project that never happened; P2008's shard already carries a classification concern of exactly that shape (Status cancelled -> operating). Worth checking against P2008's ProposalYear before that concern is applied. (2) EIA's 'TEMAX/TIME III' entry - which the orchestrator's fills[5] flag identifies as the source of P2008's SegmentName 'TEMAX Pipeline Expansion' - is docket CP09-68, Completed 2011-08-26, PA, 38.6 mi, 30/36-inch, $472M, 455 MMcf/d. Those numbers match P2008's recorded 33.0 mi / $500M / 395 MMcf/d only loosely (none exactly), so the 'P2008 = TEMAX/TIME III' reading is not clean either, and the row really does mix at least two projects' signals. A third possibility nobody has tested: P2008's 33.0 mi and $500M match TEAM 2014 while its name matches TEMAX and its dates match TEAM 2012, which is the signature of a row built from a wiki section covering several expansions at once - the same shared-page problem that left all 23 of this ProjectID's harvested citations describing other projects.

cross_row_leads.topic: Three more 'Appalachia to Market' Texas Eastern projects exist and are NOT in GEM under that name
cross_row_leads.note: Discovery/duplicate-watch lead for whoever sweeps TETCO next. Besides this row's CP20-436 project, EIA carries: (a) 'Appalachia to Market Project (A2M Project)', Texas Eastern, OH/WV/PA/NJ, 1,000 MMcf/d, docket 'na' - CANCELLED in every release 2018-05 to 2026-08; (b) 'Appalachia to Market II (Armagh-Entriken HP Replacement Project)', docket CP22-486, PA/NJ, 2 mi, 36-inch, 55 MMcf/d, $368M, status Construction, in-service now 2027 - Enbridge describes it in its FY2021 10-K as moving '55 MDth per day on the Texas Eastern pipeline from the Appalachia supply basin in Southwest Pennsylvania to existing local distribution company customers in New Jersey'; (c) 'Appalachia to Market III Project', docket CP25-491, DE/PA, 2 mi, 36-inch, 32 MMcf/d, $42.2M, status Approved. (b) and (c) are in-development US gas projects that belong in the in-dev/discovery leg if GEM does not already carry them under other names; (a) is a cancelled-row candidate. All three must be kept distinct from THIS row - the shared name is exactly the trap that produced the TETCO identity tangle in this batch.

summary: P5835 is definitively the Appalachia to Market Project, FERC docket CP20-436-000 (172 FERC para 62,184, 30 Sep 2020), a 0.8-mi 30-inch loop downstream of the Delmont Compressor Station in Westmoreland County PA plus crossovers in Berks and Fayette Counties, moving 18,000 Dth/d to UGI Utilities near Reading, in service 1 November 2021 - real, correctly classified operating, and not a duplicate of any sibling TETCO row or of the cancelled A2M / A2M II / A2M III projects that share its name. GEM's SegmentName 'TEAM 2021 Expansion' is a coinage found in no source and should be restated as 'Appalachia to Market Project (FERC CP20-436)'. All 15 worklist units are reported: 10 REFS_ADDED on two independent hosts, 4 fills (ProposalYear/Month 2020-05, ConstructionYear 2021, FuelSource 'Appalachian Basin', Operator 'Texas Eastern Transmission LP', plus StartMonth1 11 and Westmoreland County prefectures), and 1 UNRESOLVED (Pressure - no MAOP is stated anywhere in the FERC record). One spec correction is staged: LengthKnown 1.00 -> 0.80 mi, on four sources across three origins; SegmentCost 22M is kept as rounding of the sourced $21.5M.
